approvalScope: One read-only comparison of existing S1 Actor-run metadata and B1 source-store metadata using the existing configured Apify account credential, followed by at most one Main-assigned read-only Console access/share settings view only if both GETs succeed but individual grant context remains unknown.

client.library: existing pinned apify-client dependency from B2-S1 lockfile
client.authCategory: existing configured Apify CLI account token captured in memory only

apiSequence.nextStep: Only on a valid matching run response, request store metadata once. Otherwise stop.
Stop after response or error; no further API calls.

conditionalConsoleView.trigger: Both API responses succeed and relevant individual grant context remains unknown.
conditionalConsoleView.executor: Only if separately assigned by Main after API evidence review.
conditionalConsoleView.limit: One attempt through the existing authenticated Console session to view the existing store detail page Actions > Share settings only. Console navigation may make additional UI requests; the two-GET API cap does not apply to the UI network. No keys, records, body previews, grant edits, invitations, new login/account, broader inventory, or personal grant details retained.
conditionalConsoleView.preflight: Assigned read-only Explorer reported no browser available. No browser became available after the owner availability opportunity; no Console page view, login, or additional API request occurred.

forbidden: Any API request beyond the two listed GETs
Retry, fallback account, new login, new credential, or permission/access change
Dataset/log/source write, publisher/Google News request, extraction, or B2/B3 continuation
Printing/logging/persisting token, raw user ID, email, username, signed URL, signing key, or unrelated response metadata

cost.apiAccountCharges: unknown; do not assume zero or guaranteed free

execution.priorS1RuntimePermissionEvidence: S1 run log separately records LIMITED_PERMISSIONS; B2-P1 run generalAccess is a run-resource sharing field, not the Actor runtime permission level.
execution.generalAccessInterpretation: FOLLOW_USER_SETTING means the resource inherits the account-level general visibility setting. The effective setting was not observed; it does not reveal Restricted/Read or individual grants.
execution.stop: No further API, Console, permission, credential, build/run, record read, or extraction action is authorized by B2-P1.
